original_value: A fictional desktop monitor designed for color-critical creative work and immersive media viewing. The Quill features a 27-inch 3840x2160 OLED panel, 144Hz refresh rate, HDR support, USB-C display input, and an aluminum stand with tilt, swivel, and height adjustment. It is positioned as a premium display for graphic design, photo editing, and gaming setups.
